apiName: VCF Automation API - VM Apps Org - Deployment

specificationRepositoryCoverage.note: The Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository publishes OpenAPI documents for SDDC Manager, VCF Installer, VCF Operations and related components. It publishes no document for VCF Automation, the VCF 9.1 successor to vRealize/Aria Automation. The Broadcom xAPIs reference pages for this API likewise offer no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document. docs/contract.json is therefore transcribed by hand from the rendered reference pages listed below, not extracted from a published specification.

operationIdProvenance: The rendered reference pages expose operation titles but no operationId values. The operationId strings in docs/contract.json are author-assigned stable handles for the titled operations recorded below; they are not published Broadcom identifiers.

pages.title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Deployment
pages.documents: API overview: product, name, and the 9.1 / 9.0 reference versions. No specification download is offered.

pages.title: VCF Automation API Operations Index | VM Apps Org - Deployment
pages.documents: Operation index used to confirm the titled operations Get Deployment Actions, Submit Deployment Action Request and Get Request belong to this API.

pages.title: Get Deployment Actions
pages.documents: operation getDeploymentActions (GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/actions): path parameter, 200/401/404 statuses, and the ResourceAction array response.

pages.title: Submit Deployment Action Request
pages.documents: operation submitDeploymentActionRequest (POST /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests): ResourceActionRequest body, 200/401/403/404/409 statuses, and the Request response.

pages.title: Get Request
pages.documents: operation getRequest (GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}): path parameter, absence of query parameters, 200/401/404 statuses, and the Request response polled for a terminal status.

pages.title: ResourceActionRequest
pages.documents: Request body schema for submitDeploymentActionRequest: actionId, inputs and reason, all three optional.

pages.title: Request
pages.documents: Response schema shared by submitDeploymentActionRequest and getRequest, including the required members completedTasks, createdAt, name, requestedBy and totalTasks, and the twelve allowed status values.

pages.title: ResourceAction
pages.documents: Element schema of the getDeploymentActions response array: id, name, displayName, actionType, valid and description, all optional.
